name: Frédéric Martin
headline: Expert in Business Operations Excellence |  Transformation | Digitalization | Continuous improvements | Supply Chain
summary:
Versatile professional with 20+ years of solid expertise in Business Transformation, Digitalization, and
Continuous Improvement across end-to-end supply chain processes and customer support, with a Master’s
degree in Business and Supply Chain. Proven track record in leading strategic initiatives in process
standardization, customer service digitalization, and operational excellence across Europe. Bring a strong
combination of technical know-how, digital tools, and lean manufacturing methodology, supported by a datadriven mindset and the ability to translate analytics into strategic decisions. Empathetic leader committed to fostering collaboration and delivering impactful results.

positions.title: Head of Business Operations Excellence | Europe
positions.description:
- Drove strategic transformation programs across Customer Support and Supply Chain operations, embedding a continuous improvement mindset across the Forecast-to-Fulfilment value chain
- Developed and executed the Business Operations strategy, leading end-to-end transformational initiatives to increase efficiency and align processes with diverse customer needs
- Ensured regional process standardization and operational excellence across functions, enhancing
performance and scalability
- Established and led a Business Operations Excellence team, managing Business Analysts, Project Managers, and Continuous Improvement Specialist
- Led customer support digitalization initiatives, including order digitization (Esker), CRM implementation
(Dynamics), and deployment of telephony systems (Teams, Unexus); defined and implemented KPIs to
measure service levels and drive improvement (e.g. digital and untouched order ratios).
- Defined and deployed Service Packages to balance value-added services for key customers with standardized solutions for long-tail customers
- Developed and implemented voice of customer concepts and direct customer access to order tracking.
- Designed and drove the implementation of business operations dashboards (SAP Cloud Analytics) to enable data-driven decision-making and new ways of working.
- Identified improvement opportunities and led DMAIC-based initiatives to reduce manual activities, and resolve process gaps in collaboration with process owners.
- Communicated progress, risks, and results to executive management and stakeholders.

Key achievements:
- Led CRM (Dynamics) deployment and order digitization (Esker), increasing digital order intake ratio by 50% and reducing manual order changes handling by 30%.
- Established project portfolio management governance for 25+ projects
- Embedded CI culture using DMAIC methodology, eliminating outstanding payments issues of a total of 1,0 Mio€, reducing customer penalties by 25% and credit notes by 12%

• Supervise corporate Quality Audit and external Audit ISO 9001 and IATF, lead Quality Audits in the sales affiliates and supervise training for the quality representatives

company.name: tesa
company.description:
As a multinational company, tesa develops innovative adhesive tapes and self-adhesive product solutions for various industries, commercial customers, and end consumers. There are already more than 7,000 tesa adhesive solutions that help improve the work, products or lives of our customers. Today, the focus is on sustainability and energy-saving processes. tesa invests in the development of environmentally friendly products and solvent-free manufacture processes as well as in the use of renewable energy sources at its locations. 

tesa is active in 100 countries and operates plants in Germany, Italy, China, the USA, and in Vietnam. Around three quarters of the tesa Group’s sales (2023: EUR 1.7 billion euro) are generated by applications for industries. Together with its international clients, tesa develops innovations that are customized at product and process level. Already more than 130 tesa tapes may be installed in an electric car and over 70 in a smartphone. In the printing and construction industries, too, tesa is constantly penetrating new segments and countries with its special adhesive tapes. The company generates almost one quarter of its sales with products for end consumers and professional craftsmen. 300 applications, such as the legendary tesafilm®, make life easier or, when it comes to insect protection, even make it a bit more pleasant. tesa counts among the world’s leading manufacturers of adhesive solutions. Since 2001, tesa SE is an independent 100% affiliate of Beiersdorf AG (i.e., NIVEA, Eucerin, la prairie) with approx. 5,200 employees today.
